mapper.insert: INSERT INTO checklist (user_id, title, template_id, items, list_date, order_index, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{templateId}, #{itemsJson}, #{date}, #{orderIndex}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS user_id, title, template_id AS template_id, items, list_date AS list_date, order_index AS order_index, create_time AS create_time, update_time AS update_time FROM checklist WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY list_date DESC, order_index ASC, create_time DESC

SELECT id, user_id AS user_id, title, template_id AS template_id, items, list_date AS list_date, order_index AS order_index, create_time AS create_time, update_time AS update_time FROM checklist WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND list_date = #{date} ORDER BY order_index ASC, create_time DESC

SELECT id, user_id AS user_id, title, template_id AS template_id, items, list_date AS list_date, order_index AS order_index, create_time AS create_time, update_time AS update_time FROM checklist WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
